violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed cut tomato at 44F, cut lettuce at 45F, pickles at 45F, coleslaw at 44F, sliced Mozzarella cheese at 47F in 3 DR prep cooler next to oven (44F). Observed milk at 47F and half&half at 47F in 2 DR UC at service area (48F).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded all aforementioned TCS food items. PIC moved all TCS food items that had been in that unit for not more than 4 hours to the proper working refrigerator .

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not resistant to corrosion: Observed chipped wooden pizza peels used for preparing pizza.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. Please replace wooden pizza peels.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 3 DR prep cooler next to oven at 44F and 2 DR UC Avantco at service area at 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC will discontinue use of units until repairs completed. PIC contacted technician during the inspection. PIC will email proof of repair once the repair is complete.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: working containers of spices , squeeze bottles of oil, soy sauce, hot honey stored on cook line and throughout establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC labeled all working containers and squeeze bottles.

violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: EHS observed drip pans in the warmer oven not clean to sight and touch
